composition_subtypes.role: Uses two deques as monotonic queues to maintain min and max of the sliding window in amortized O(1).

payload.composition_order: Iterate right pointer, update deques, slide left pointer when condition violated.
payload.core_composition_summary: Sliding window with two monotonic deques to find longest subarray where max-min <= k.
payload.rationale: Single mechanism: classic sliding window with monotonic queues (amortized_monotonic_queue) combining data structures for O(n) time.
